ios.desc:
Make your friends laugh with a message made just for them! Type a friend's name, pick a celebrity-style AI voice and a template, and Parodist turns it into a funny clip: a joke, a greeting, a birthday wish or a voicemail greeting.

HOW IT WORKS
• Type your friend's name
• Pick a voice and a template from the library, sorted by language and voice
• Play your clip, then send it as a voice message, a video or a link, or save the video to your photo library

YOUR OWN TEXT
With Parodist PRO, type anything you like (up to 150 characters) and hear it in any voice.

8 LANGUAGES
The app and the voices speak English, Italian, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Russian. Choose which voice languages you see in Settings.

PARODIST PRO
• All voices and templates
• Unlimited clips
• Your own text in any voice

GOOD TO KNOW
All voices in Parodist are AI-generated parodies with cartoon avatars. They are not the real people, and those people are not involved with the app and do not endorse it. Parodist is for fun and entertainment only.
Names are checked automatically before they are voiced, and offensive content is not voiced.
Parodist never makes phone calls. You decide who gets your clip.

SUBSCRIPTION
Parodist PRO is an auto-renewable subscription: weekly, with a 3-day free trial. Some users can also choose a yearly plan with a 3-day free trial. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase or, if you start a free trial, when the trial ends.
• The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period.
• Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings. Cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends to avoid the next charge.

Terms of Use: https://parodist.ai/rules_en
Privacy Policy: https://parodist.ai/politics_en

Questions or ideas? Write to us at hello@parodist.ai
